"""BEHAVIOR-1K setting_the_fire episode client harness.

The configured rcb-limited/2.0 service did not accept a TCP connection during
this run (Robot(timeout=600) ended with connection refused on sim:8000 and
localhost:8000). Consequently no observation or robot action was available.
This script preserves the client setup and, if the service is available when
rerun, records its spec and the initial camera views for subsequent control.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

# Robot waits up to ten minutes for the simulator endpoint, as in the episode.
r = Robot(timeout=600)
spec = r.spec()
(OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
obs = r.get_obs(video="frames")
(OUT / "initial_obs_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
try:
    from PIL import Image
    for camera, frame in obs.last.items():
        name = camera.replace(":", "_")
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"initial_{name}.jpg")
except ImportError:
    import numpy as np
    for camera, frame in obs.last.items():
        name = camera.replace(":", "_")
        np.save(OUT / f"initial_{name}.npy", frame)

print("Connected and recorded initial observations; no actions were submitted.")
